Run speech recognition and speech synthesis on your own mac"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"hine, with optional external providers."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DSH Live Voice - You and Your Team / 实时语音 - 您和您的团队"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | Português (Brasil) | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**Talk to your AI assistant, listen to its answers, and bring meeting context into the conversation—"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"without constantly switching back to the keyboard.**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"DSH Live Voice is a local-first voice plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), with speech-to-text (STT), "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"text-to-speech (TTS), and real-time meeting transcription."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"_Speak to your assistant, listen to its answers, and control the conversation without returning to t"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"r assistant, listen to its answers, and control the conversation without returning to the keyboard._"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"_Built in Brazil 🇧🇷 and tested daily with Brazilian Portuguese on macOS._"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## ⚡ Quick Start"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**Tested with DeepSeek Harness v0.2.2-rc.1.**"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Install the prebuilt package from npm with `npx dsh` into your DSH web profile (no source build requ"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"l the prebuilt package from npm with `npx dsh` into your DSH web profile (no source build required):"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Open **DSH Settings → Live Voice** after your next DSH startup."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## What can you do with it?"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- **Work by voice:** dictate a request, talk through code or documents, and hear the assistant’s res"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ponse while staying focused on your work.
- **Bring your AI assistant into the meeting:** capture th"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"e discussion, review the transcript, and ask for help comparing proposals or summarizing decisions. "},{"id":"p15s4","text":"Meeting audio capture and sharing the assistant’s voice require separate setup; this is not a native"},{"id":"p15s5","text":" Meet or Teams integration.
- **Stay in control:** review before sending, choose manual or automatic"},{"id":"p15s6","text":" delivery, and pause, resume, or stop spoken answers. See the conversation flow guide for listening "},{"id":"p15s7","text":"and interruption controls.
- **Choose your speech setup:** use local recognition and speech engines "},{"id":"p15s8","text":"where supported, or configure an HTTP endpoint. Local-first voice does not mean DSH or its AI provid"},{"id":"p15s9","text":"er is fully offline."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## ✨ Features at a Glance"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- 🎙️ **Voice Typing:** Append final recognized speech to the end of the DSH composer without replaci"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ng manual edits.
- 👐 **Hands-Free Conversation:** Continuous dialogue that stays active across chat "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"sessions.
- ❓ **Spoken Structured Questions:** Narrates DSH prompt questions and submits your spoken"},{"id":"p17s4","text":" answer.
- ⌨️ **Optional Hold-to-Talk (Push-to-Talk):** Enable it in Settings, then hold `Control` a"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"nywhere on the page to speak; release to queue the message after the configured send delay. Disabled"},{"id":"p17s6","text":" by default.
- 🎧 **Acoustic Mode Isolation:** Gated listening for speakers (no echo) and open-mic in"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"terruption for headphones.
- 🗣️ **Spoken Commands:** Control the chat using phrases like _"send"_, _"},{"id":"p17s8","text":""mute"_, _"clear"_, and _"stop speaking"_.
- ⭐ **Dedicated Speech Bar:** Smoothly scrolling approxim"},{"id":"p17s9","text":"ate captions, a moving highlight, previous/next navigation, pause/resume, stop, and a current/total "},{"id":"p17s10","text":"segment counter. Captions show the text sent to the speech engine, without claiming word-level align"},{"id":"p17s11","text":"ment.
- 🔊 **Speech Volume:** Save a playback volume from silent to full in Speech settings for Brows"},{"id":"p17s12","text":"er, Say, and Qwen, without changing microphone input.
- 🧹 **Markdown-Aware Speech:** Remove formatti"},{"id":"p17s13","text":"ng, announce links without reading full URLs, shorten file paths and line references, read checkbox "},{"id":"p17s14","text":"states and table rows, and replace long code blocks with a localized notice. Preserve custom notices"},{"id":"p17s15","text":".
- ⚡ **Responsive Conversation Settings:** Automatic-send delays of 600 ms, 800 ms, or 1–6 seconds "},{"id":"p17s16","text":"(4 seconds by default), plus an assistant response delay of 600 ms, 1.5, 2, 3, 4 or 5 seconds (1.5 s"},{"id":"p17s17","text":"econds by default). Recognition and synthesis still contribute to overall latency.
- 🛠️ **Optional L"},{"id":"p17s18","text":"ive Voice Debugger:** Install `dsh-live-voice-debugger` separately to inspect runtime state and queu"},{"id":"p17s19","text":"es from the Developer tab in Live Voice Settings. The main plugin works without it.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### You control what is captured and sent"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- Shared audio and your microphone have separate controls and can be stopped independently. Normal v"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"oice commands and assistant speech remain available.
- With both sources capturing, source changes i"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"ntroduce `Me:` or `Them:`; consecutive chunks continue on the same line; configured longer pauses st"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"art new paragraphs. Customize the microphone and shared-audio names in **Live Voice Settings → Conve"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"rsation → Meeting mode** (defaults: `Me` / `Them`). Names are saved when you leave the field; blank "},{"id":"p19s6","text":"restores the default, with a maximum of 80 single-line characters. Changes apply to new source block"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"s without rewriting existing text. These labels distinguish audio sources, **not individual meeting "},{"id":"p19s8","text":"participants**.
- An optional **Timestamp** clock toggle adds local timestamps such as `[YYYY/MM/DD "},{"id":"p19s9","text":"HH:MM:SS]` to new source blocks, using chunk onset rather than recognition completion. It is off by "},{"id":"p19s10","text":"default and never rewrites earlier text.
- Microphone and shared-audio bars mirror each other: the l"},{"id":"p19s11","text":"eading icon toggles **Listening / Ignoring**, with independent exact-command, timestamp, and Manual "},{"id":"p19s12","text":"/ Queue / Steer controls. Both use the same delivery countdown and cancel action. Ignoring does not "},{"id":"p19s13","text":"end capture; stop sharing through **Meeting mode → Stop audio sharing** in the composer. The existin"},{"id":"p19s14","text":"g shared-audio shortcut still starts or stops capture directly. Enabled commands and automatic deliv"},{"id":"p19s15","text":"ery follow each source’s controls; review commands before enabling them for participant audio."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Audio availability depends on the browser, operating system, and sharing surface. This is **not a bu"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ilt-in Google Meet or Teams integration**. Capturing meeting audio and sharing the assistant’s voice"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" back into a call require separate setup. Use headphones to reduce feedback, and obtain appropriate "},{"id":"p20s4","text":"participant consent before capturing a meeting. Transcription and AI responses have processing laten"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"cy; “real-time” does not mean instantaneous or guaranteed accurate."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Compatible HTTP servers"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"See HTTP engine contracts for the routes and request/response payloads expected by the TTS and STT a"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" engine contracts for the routes and request/response payloads expected by the TTS and STT adapters."}],"truncated":true}
